TypographyVortexCanvas registered source

Source bundle: https://threeui.com/source-code/typography-vortex.json
Supplied source revision: 5a736cd3c1f6f19802f61ebb10e1701b9f7aa26e
Retrieved: 2026-10-01

The three registered source files are stored byte-for-byte, without edits.
Their SHA-256 hashes and the font hash are checked by scripts/build-animation.mjs.
The supplied revision is a ThreeUI source identifier, not a verified public
GitHub commit. Provenance is established by the registered bundle and hashes.

The font was decoded from the ThreeUI Fragment Mono data URI in the official
@designcodeio/threeui@1.2.0 package's lib-dist/style.css. The npm tarball's
registry integrity was verified before extraction. Font size: 15176 bytes.

Package tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@designcodeio/threeui/-/threeui-1.2.0.tgz

Licenses: LICENSE.txt (ThreeUI MIT), FONT-LICENSES.txt (Fragment Mono OFL).

Integration: src/animation/mount.ts is the site's native DOM/canvas adapter.
After the exact-component integration, the user requested faster startup and
website-specific words. The adapter now invokes the verified renderer directly,
without React, the shared ThreeUI stylesheet, or a downloaded animation font.
Its phrase names Balhence and published security services. Other rendering
settings retain the requested values: dark, speed 1, ringGrowth 1.21, opacity 1,
dissolveRadius 1, particleAmount 1 and suctionDuration 920.

Only the renderer is bundled at runtime. The source component, shared CSS and
font remain here as verified provenance; the latter two are not published or
requested by the website. The renderer's system monospace fallback is used.
type-field.css supplies the small site-specific canvas layout. The script is
loaded asynchronously from the page head and mounts when the hero is parsed;
it does not wait for fonts, footer scripts or DOMContentLoaded.

The site adapter positions the component behind hero content and forwards
pointer events without preventing links or native touch scrolling. The source
renderer owns ring rendering, pointer dissolution, dust, click suction,
offscreen suspension and document visibility. The registered component and
renderer remain byte-for-byte intact.

The adapter does not mount animated decoration for reduced motion, slow
display updates, data saving, forced colors or printing. The site's static
background remains visible in those modes and if Canvas 2D is unavailable.

Rebuild after editing the adapter:
  npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
  npm run build:animation
  npm run check:animation

type-field.js is committed for the static hosting workflow. CI verifies that
it matches the pinned dependencies and checked source before deployment.
